# Validation labels: fixing N/M and checking fix N/M (KAN-102)

## What to build

While the validation fixer works, its node shows `fixing N/M`; while the gate re-checks the fix, the gate node shows `checking fix N/M` (replacing `revalidate N/M`). The two labels never overlap. Applies to the engine's run page and graph-manager. The spec is `docs/prd/done/isolated-workspaces.md`; read its Decisions and Requirements sections for this slice.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/runpage.js` (lines 22–28) — `statusText`: `fixing` and `revalidate` labels today.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/suitepage.js` — same label for suites (grep `revalidat`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/status.ts`, `pages/TaskGraph.tsx`, `pages/PhaseCards.tsx` — graph-manager's status text and the Validation card.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (`GATE_NODE`, `AGENT_NODE.gateFixer`) — node ids.

## Step-by-step tasks

- **UPDATE** `runpage.js`/`suitepage.js` `statusText`: gate node `validating` with a round → `checking fix N/M`; fixer node `fixing` → `fixing N/M`. Hide the gate's round label while the fixer node is `running`/`fixing`, and lay the labels out so the gate's and the fixer's never share a position (check the CSS of node labels in the run page).
- **UPDATE** graph-manager's status text and the Validation phase card the same way (`fixing N/M` / `checking fix N/M`).
- **ADD tests**: the engine's web test that covers `statusText` (grep `revalidate` in `*.test.ts` and update it) and `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PhaseCards.test.ts` / `ui/status.test.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `revalidate` text remains on either page.
- [ ] A gate re-check round shows `checking fix 1/3`; the fixer shows `fixing 1/3`.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test
```
